activity.notes: Edward IV first became King of England in 1461 after the Yorkist victory at Towton. His first reign ended in 1470 when he fled to the Low Countries and Henry VI was restored. ATLAS records this first English kingship separately from Edward's continued Yorkist faction leadership and from his restored second reign.

sources.title: Edward IV — The Royal Family
sources.citation_text: The Royal Family gives Edward IV's first reign as 1461-1470, describes his flight to the Low Countries in 1470, and Henry VI's restoration.

sources.title: King Edward IV — National Portrait Gallery
sources.citation_text: The National Portrait Gallery identifies Edward IV as the first Yorkist king and gives his reigns as 1461-1470 and 1471-1483.
